android.title: Block Dungeons
android.shortDescription: Explore Mossy Hollow, battle monsters and find your way to the beacon.
android.fullDescription:
A quiet forest hides an old ruin. Take up your sword and bow, cross the river and survive the ambush in Mossy Hollow.

Read your enemies, time your three-hit sword combo, roll away from danger and make every arrow count. Collect emeralds and supplies, open chests and gates, and reach the exit beacon. Checkpoints and limited lives give each attempt a second chance.

Block Dungeons includes one handcrafted adventure with zombies, skeleton archers and original cuboid art. Replay the mission to improve your result, or import a compatible custom level package.

Adjust sound levels, text size and touch controls to suit your play.
